annotations.title: Look up class and service prices

description: Use this when someone asks what their gym charges for a class, personal training session or other service. Returns catalog service names with price and last edit time for one gym, alphabetical, 25 per page by default. Not for what a particular member bought or attended.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page of this listing; absent for the first page

gymId.description: Id of one of the user's gyms, as the gym list returns it (24 lowercase hex characters)

name: list_services

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

services.description: Service catalog entries, alphabetical. Service ids, member history, notes, staff commissions, organization ids and arbitrary metadata are excluded.

title: Look up class and service prices
